purpose: Paired fresh-Agent preflight for FD4 World/Host/Runtime/Computing documentation rewrites under editorial-discipline-v2.
providerFamily: DeepSeek credentials admitted under /root/.config/ordivon/secrets; exact slot/model recorded per trial

subjectProtocol.instruction: use only supplied exact-revision documents; do not import prior Ordivon knowledge; preserve unknown/currentness/authority boundaries

tasks.prompt: A message transport records successful delivery. May the system now claim the destination Agent knows or understood the content?

oracle.decision: No; delivery/receipt is not destination knowledge, cognition, or semantic acceptance.
requiredPoints: transport occurrence and receiver semantics differ
native/receiver evidence is needed for stronger claims

tasks.prompt: A resource was observed present yesterday, then no current observation is available. May a current decision treat yesterday’s Presence as current truth?

oracle.decision: No; historical occurrence remains historical evidence and current Presence requires applicable owner-native observation/reconciliation.
requiredPoints: historical truth and currentness are distinct
World should preserve exact external identity and reobserve/reconcile
criticalErrors: a projection becomes global current-state authority

tasks.prompt: An Agent session disappears halfway through a long task and a different Agent must continue later. What must survive, and which details should not become the durable owner of the work?

oracle.decision: Host preserves durable semantic Task continuity/checkpoints/commitments; Provider/session state is replaceable.
requiredPoints: Task identity and semantic frontier survive session replacement
checkpoint is a working claim that points back to owner truth
transport/provider session is not Task authority
criticalErrors: persist the chat transcript as authoritative task state
treat Provider session identity as work identity

tasks.prompt: Runtime reports a local Job succeeded. May Host now mark the whole Task complete? Explain the missing proof boundary.

oracle.decision: Not from Runtime success alone; Host/domain completion requires the relevant verification and semantic outcome admission.
requiredPoints: physical execution and semantic completion are different
domain/world truth may still be external
Task outcome remains Host/domain scoped
criticalErrors: Runtime exit status automatically completes Task
Host execution persistence makes Host domain truth owner

tasks.prompt: A local command exits 0 after requesting an external effect, but the external provider response is lost. What has Runtime proved, and what remains unknown?

oracle.decision: Runtime proved admitted local execution facts; external occurrence/domain success remains unknown until owner-native reconciliation.
requiredPoints: local process success is physical evidence only
external provider/domain owns outside occurrence truth
do not infer or blindly redispatch
criticalErrors: missing response means failure and safe retry

tasks.prompt: The client loses the response to workspace.exec and reconnects. Should it invent a new operation identity? What is the safe recovery path?

oracle.decision: Reuse/recover the same committed request identity and observe/reconcile it; do not create a duplicate just because delivery is uncertain.
requiredPoints: stable clientRequestId/Job identity supports replay/observation
reconnect through list/get/observe when needed
criticalErrors: new client request is harmless after response loss
Runtime replay proves arbitrary external exactly-once effects

tasks.prompt: A future model absorbs most Tool loops, memory, subagents, and planning. What, if anything, should Ordivon Computing still insist on preserving, and what should it avoid freezing into a permanent stack?

oracle.decision: Preserve only residual durable responsibilities that remain unowned after stronger classical/provider baselines; subsystem names are not invariants.
requiredPoints: owner-native/classical mechanisms remain preferred when sufficient
durable responsibilities may survive while package boundaries change
temporary model limitations do not justify permanent shared layers
criticalErrors: treat Host/Harness/Runtime/World names as a mandatory eternal stack

tasks.prompt: Computing prose says a project is current in state A, but the owning repository at an exact current revision proves state B. Which source controls the current implementation claim and what role does Computing retain?

oracle.decision: The owner repository controls current product truth; Computing retains cross-project synthesis/research authority.
requiredPoints: owner-native exact source/evidence outranks Computing summary
Computing may revise its synthesis from owner evidence
criticalErrors: let Computing override owner implementation truth
treat a historical snapshot as floating current state

decisionRules: Any baseline-majority-correct to treatment-majority-wrong result blocks publication.
Any new treatment critical over-inference absent from baseline blocks publication until resolved.
No task/oracle/judge rubric may change after the first live Provider call.

When baseline and treatment are both ceiling-correct, lower input/token burden is preferred; material treatment burden increase without new decision benefit triggers contraction review, especially for Runtime and Computing.
Publication currentness remains independent of reader quality: a treatment can pass preflight yet remain fenced if owner-current authority is moving.
